subject: Pilot top-up request — one-off credits to secure Q4 close
messages:
From: Sam Reynolds <sam@forgepath.ai>
To: vivek_kulkarni@redwood.ai
Date: Wed, 21 Oct 2026 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Pilot top-up request — one-off credits to secure Q4 close

Hi Vivek,

Quick ask from our side — the team at ForgePath would like to extend the existing pilot by ~3 weeks but we’re bumping into token limits. We’ve seen meaningful uplift in evals after the last model tweak and we need a small one-off top-up of credits to finish the integration work and finalize a procurement decision before the end of Q4.

What we’re proposing: a one-time credit equivalent to ~30k inference tokens (roughly $1.8k) and a 30-day trial extension to allow an extra round of user testing. If Redwood can do that, procurement is comfortable moving to a committed Dedicated trial next month.

Attached is a short note from our procurement team outlining timelines.

Would appreciate a quick yes/no so we can lock the pilot dates. Happy to jump on a 10-min call.

Thanks,
Sam
Sam Reynolds
Head of ML Integrations, ForgePath
forgepath.ai
attachment: forgepath_topup_request.pdf (pdf)

From: vivek_kulkarni@redwood.ai
To: ben_carter@redwood.ai, grace_oconnor@redwood.ai
Cc: laura_bennett@redwood.ai
Date: Wed, 21 Oct 2026 10:03:00 -07:00
Subject: Fwd: Pilot top-up request — one-off credits to secure Q4 close

Folks — forwarding ForgePath’s ask (summary below). Small, time-boxed credit + 30-day extension. This is high-leverage: they’ve completed integrations and this pilot extension is the gating item for a Dedicated POC and likely a paid contract next month (deal FORGE-3491).

Suggested approach: authorize a one-time credit sized to the ask (30k tokens / ~$1.8k) and allow a 30-day extension. If OK, we’ll issue a short amendment and route to DocuSign.

Questions: finance/discount authority? legal on a short amendment? Ben — can you greenlight? Grace — can you sign if this meets approval thresholds? Laura — please prepare amendment template and attach to the DocuSign link.

Thanks,
Vivek
Vivek Kulkarni
Director, Strategic Sales — Redwood Inference

Vivek — fine to proceed. Approve the one-time credit up to $2k (or 35k tokens) as a sales-facilitated concession. This fits within our Q4 conversion playbook — small token top-ups that remove friction are high ROI.

Notes for execution:
- Mark it one-off; no precedent for ongoing discounts.
- Include explicit expiration (30 days) and tie to the current pilot agreement (FORGE-3491).
- Finance: please book as promotional credit; don’t change MRR assumptions.

Grace/Laura — please push the amendment template and DocuSign link. Vivek — drop me the exact numbers before sending to Sam.

Ben

All — I can sign off. Approved: one-time credit equivalent to 35k tokens (we’ll record as $2,000 promotional credit) plus a 30-day extension to the pilot. Conditions:
- Credit is one-off and not refundable; applies only to the pilot envelope.
- Pilot extension fixed to 30 days from the current pilot end date.
- Document amendment must be routed through legal and executed via DocuSign (Laura, please attach the short amendment and set signer order).

I’ve prepared a quick signature packet — Laura, please attach and send to Sam with the DocuSign link below. Once signed, instruct finance to grant the credit to the account (deal FORGE-3491).

Grace

- Adds a one-time promotional credit of $2,000 (35k tokens) to your pilot account
- Extends the pilot period by 30 days from the current end date
